entities.summary: Dutch West India Company, a political institution in Suriname during European Colonization and the Dutch Takeover (1667–1700). Grew from Dutch establish plantation economy with enslaved African labour and Dutch capture Suriname — February 1667. Led to the emergence of Treaty of Breda.
